content.text: For digital creators in regions where PayPal and Stripe are unavailable, finding a reliable hosting solution for online stores can be a daunting challenge. In countries across Africa and South Asia, creators often face restrictions that limit their ability to sell digital products. This is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-every-5|github]] Pages comes into play as a powerful alternative for hosting digital product stores. With no platform fees or reliance on conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-explained-digital-creators-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-18|USDT Payment]] processors, GitHub Pages allows creators to establish their own commerce infrastructure seamlessly and efficiently.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Using GitHub Pages not only provides a cost-effective hosting solution but also grants creators full ownership and control over their digital assets. This means that once the store is set up, the creator is not bound by any subscription fees or platform dependence, reinforcing the concept of sovereignty in digital commerce. By leveraging GitHub's infrastructure, creators can focus on developing their products rather than worrying about the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Furthermore, product delivery can be efficiently managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, enabling automatic file distribution upon payment confirmation. This setup not only reduces operational overhead but also minimizes delays in product access for customers, ensuring they receive their purchases as quickly as possible. By understanding how these components interconnect, creators can build a robust digital product store that functions independently of traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Moreover, this approach is ideal for creators who are looking to maximize their profits. By eliminating excessive platform fees and providing a straightforward way to handle transactions, creators can keep more of what they earn. This model empowers them to reinvest in their work, scale their operations, and create higher-quality products for their audience. The ability to sell directly to customers without intermediary restrictions means greater flexibility and opportunity for growth.
GitHub Pages allows you to host your store without platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Next, NOWPayments acts as the payment processor, allowing for the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee structure. This is particularly beneficial for creators in regions with unstable fiat currencies, as they can receive payments in crypto without incurring high fees. Lastly, products can be stored and delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that files are readily available to customers immediately after purchase. Together, these components create a streamlined system that empowers creators to run their digital product stores efficiently and independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Next, sign up for NOWPayments and set up your account to accept cryptocurrency payments. Ensure you configure the payment integration to function with your GitHub Pages store. Finally, make use of Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to manage product storage and automatic delivery. With these steps completed, you will have a fully operational digital product store that allows you to sell your products and retain full ownership without relying on conventional payment platforms. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use GitHub Pages along with a payment processor like NOWPayments. This combination allows you to host your store for free and accept cryptocurrencies, bypassing the need for traditional payment platforms. This setup ensures low fees and complete ownership over your sales.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on transactions, a fraction of what platforms like Gumroad charge.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to explore more options for establishing your own digital product store, check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the blueprints and templates necessary to build and deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. For more resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository. Next, configure GitHub Pages in your repository settings to publish your site. Build your storefront using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or choose a template to expedite the process. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend order management. Sign up for NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments and configure it with your store. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product storage and automatic delivery. Test the entire workflow to ensure everything functions correctly before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I really host my digital product store for free?
Yes, GitHub Pages offers free hosting for static websites, allowing you to create and manage your digital product store without incurring hosting fees.
How do I process payments without PayPal or Stripe?
You can use NOWPayments as your payment processor, which allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees.

Is this setup secure for my customers?
Yes, using NOWPayments ensures secure transactions, as it verifies payments on-chain, providing both you and your customers with peace of mind.
How quickly can I get my store up and running?
With the right tools and guidance, you can deploy your GitHub Pages store within 48 hours, making it a quick and efficient solution for selling digital products.
